name: nan-builders-vscode
description: Use NaN Builders models natively in VS Code Chat and Agent mode.

apiKey.title: API Key
apiKey.markdownDescription: NaN Builders API key. Stored securely; leave empty to keep the key set via **NaN Builders: Manage Provider**.

apiBaseUrl.title: API Base URL
apiBaseUrl.markdownDescription: OpenAI-compatible base URL. Leave empty to use the `nanBuilders.apiBaseUrl` setting.

nanBuilders.apiBaseUrl.description: NaN Builders OpenAI-compatible API base URL. Change only for development or self-hosted compatibility testing.

nanBuilders.modelCacheSeconds.description: How long the discovered model list is cached before refreshing.

nanBuilders.connectTimeoutSeconds.description: Seconds to wait for the response headers of a chat request before failing with a timeout. User cancellation is still immediate and reported separately; raise this for slow gateways.

nanBuilders.streamIdleTimeoutSeconds.description: Maximum silence between streamed chunks before a chat request is aborted as timed out. The timer restarts on every chunk, so slow but alive streams are never cut off by a total deadline. Raise it for models with long silent reasoning phases.

nanBuilders.maxParallelRequests.description: Chat requests and inline completions allowed to run at once for one API key. NaN serves up to 7 concurrent requests per key and answers more with HTTP 429, so extra requests wait in a first-in-first-out queue instead. Lower it to leave headroom for other editors or terminals using the same key. Values above 7 are capped at the gateway limit.

nanBuilders.showStatusBar.description: Show NaN usage in the VS Code status bar: plan-credit usage % when an API key is configured, otherwise local session usage.

nanBuilders.diagnostics.enabled.description: Write temporary NaN Builders extension diagnostics to the log. Enable only when troubleshooting and reload the VS Code window after changing.

nanBuilders.includeUnknownModels.description: Also show model IDs returned by NaN that are not yet in this extension's metadata catalog. Disabled by default because an unknown ID may be a non-chat endpoint; when enabled, unknown models are exposed without Agent tool-calling or vision capability.

enumDescriptions: Only show models from the local catalog, models the endpoint explicitly marks as chat, and (with includeUnknownModels) unmarked IDs.
Show every ID returned by GET /models except obvious non-chat endpoints (embeddings, rerank, transcription, image generation). Capability fields from the endpoint take precedence over defaults.
nanBuilders.discoveryMode.markdownDescription: How the model list from `GET /models` is filtered. `auto` enables Copilot-style auto-discovery for trusted OpenAI-compatible endpoints: unknown chat models appear with capabilities declared by the endpoint, or conservative defaults when none are declared. Use only with endpoints you trust.

nanBuilders.completionModel.description: Model ID for opt-in inline (ghost-text) completions. Empty disables the feature and no completion request is sent. Requests use POST /completions with the last 4,000 characters before the cursor, are aborted when you keep typing, and never show stale text.

nanBuilders.defaultReasoningEffort.markdownDescription: Reasoning effort sent to NaN when the chat request does not specify one. `auto` uses a per-model default (medium when the model documents it, otherwise the central documented level). Explicit levels are remapped to the closest level the model documents in https://nan.builders/docs/models.

nanBuilders.reasoningEffortByModel.markdownDescription: Per-model reasoning effort overrides and per-profile model routing, set by the `NaN Builders: Set Model Reasoning Effort` and `NaN Builders: Manage Provider` commands. A plain key is a model ID; a `profile::model` key assigns that model to a profile so its requests use that profile's API key. Values are effort levels remapped to the closest level the model documents, or `auto` for routing without an effort override.

nanBuilders.profiles.markdownDescription: Profile IDs managed by `NaN Builders: Manage Provider`. Only IDs are stored here; each profile's API key lives in VS Code SecretStorage under `nanBuilders.profileKey.<profileId>`. With no profiles configured, the single `nanBuilders.apiKey` key keeps working as before.

nanBuilders.activeProfile.markdownDescription: Profile whose API key serves every model without a `profile::model` entry in `nanBuilders.reasoningEffortByModel`. Empty selects the first profile. Ignored when no profiles are configured.

scripts.test: npm run compile && npm run test:unit
scripts.check: npm run clean && npm run compile && npm run test:unit && npm run test:extension && npm run test:insiders
